Blockhaven

Survive, explore grasslands, deserts, snowy taiga and shark-filled oceans, then cross into the Ember Realm. Destroy the core and slay the Ember Wyrm to win.

W A S DWalk (Shift to sprint) MouseLook around Hold left clickMine a block, or attack a zombie Right clickPlace a block, eat food, or use a crafting table or rift stone 1–0 / wheelChoose a hotbar slot EOpen inventory, armor and 2×2 crafting Hold Ctrl or ZCrouch: move slowly, stay hidden and never fall off edges Right click a bedSleep through the night and set your respawn point QDrop one of the held item (Ctrl+Q drops the stack) XSwap the item in your hand with your off hand TChat with other players in the shared world VChange the camera: first person, behind you, or in front of you so you can see what is behind you BShapeshift into an animal (needs a shapeshift totem) KChoose a skin to wear. Every skin has a special ability Creative modeSwitch it on in this menu. Double-tap jump to fly, press I for every item, and nothing can hurt you RUse your skin’s power, like shadow clones, meteor strikes or a freeze nova ThirstThe blue drops show your thirst. Fill glass bottles at water and drink them, or crouch and right-click water Hold FRaise your shield Deep oceanBeware: sea serpents and the Kraken lurk far from shore Jade portalCraft 9 jade frames, set them in a 3×3 square and fill each with a spirit eye DoorbellRight-click to ring. It also rings when someone walks up to it CavesThe ground is about 100 blocks deep, full of winding caves, ore and monsters. Glowshards hide near the bottom, and below that is a sea of lava Security tabMotion sensors sound an alarm, auto turrets shoot monsters, spike traps hurt intruders Right click a villagerTrade with them for gold coins Glider wingsWear them and jump off a cliff to soar. Look down to dive, up to climb, tap Space to flap. Rockets boost you BucketRight-click water or lava to scoop it, right-click again to pour Fishing rodRight-click to cast, wait for a fish to bite, right-click to reel in VehiclesMotorbikes, hovercraft, submarines, attack helicopters, fighter jets and battle tanks, plus Cars, a flying drill car that also swims, and big sailing ships. Right-click to get in, Shift to get out Signs, code locks, lasersWrite on signs, lock doors with a code, and lasers burn anyone you haven't invited Jade RealmPandas, red pandas, cranes, monkeys and the rare qilin live here, and Lóng the friendly Jade Dragon gives you a gift every day SpaceCraft a space rocket, hold Space to fly to the top of the sky, then pick the Moon (low gravity) or the Sun (bring fire resistance!) MOpen your map (craft one from 2 sticks + string + coal). Tap to drop pins, then follow the arrow to get there Boss fightsUse a Boss summoner (city tool shop, or craft one) to fight 50 new bosses. Each has 3 phases. Beat a helpful boss and it becomes your ally! Weapon packFind 90 new weapons at the city's Legendary armory and Ninja dojo: elemental swords, hammers that shake the ground, magic staffs and wands, ninja gear and some very silly toilet weapons. Combine an Ice sword with a Lightning sword to make a Stormfrost sword! Alien PlanetBuild an alien portal in the alien fabricator (research level 3) to visit the Alien Planet, with crystal spires, a glass-dome city and friendly alien traders Aliens on EarthCrashed UFOs are hidden somewhere in the Normal World (not on the map). Sneak up on the shy aliens to befriend them, collect alien materials and use the alien fabricator to research alien technology CampingBuy 23 kinds of tent at the city camping shop (or craft a small tent from 2 string, 2 sticks and 2 planks). Right-click the ground to pitch one Sea kingdomFind the Merfolk kingdom on your map: mermaids give you water breathing, mermen trade, and you can ride dolphins and giant sea turtles Tools & securityThe city now has tool, weapon, vehicle and security shops. Try the void pickaxe, laser drill, tree feller, builder wand, teleport staff and more, plus fake walls, painting doors (crouch + right-click a painting), vaults, private elevators, teleport pads and land claim flags Apocalypse daysApocalypse mode lasts 100 days: Infection (day 6), First Contact with aliens (16), Mutation (31), World Collapse (51), Total Annihilation (76) and the final boss on day 100 ApocalypseChoose Apocalypse difficulty in the pause menu: bites infect you, mutants and raiders roam, radiation storms, blood moons and sandstorms strike, and you must manage body temperature and clean water WorldsUnlock 7 more worlds (Lost Jungle, Frozen Kingdom, Lava Dimension, Sky Islands, Atlantis, Dragon Kingdom and the Void). Craft a World gate (4 glowshards, 4 cobblestone, iron) and right-click it to see what each world needs City & gadgetsFind the city: shops sell food for dollars and a pawn shop buys your stuff. Rumour says there is a secret lab under one building. Robots, scanners, laser doors, drills and grappling hooks are in the Technology and Security tabs SeaThe oceans are much deeper now. Watch for tsunamis and whirlpools, and listen for the Bloop in the deep Doors & defenceCage doors you can see through, automatic metal doors that scan you and only open for welcome players, and tornado bombers that blow up tornadoes and shoot monsters PaintingCraft a canvas (planks + 2 string), place it and right-click to paint your own pixel art TrainsCraft train tracks (iron + 3 sticks makes 16) and lay them in lines, turns and slopes. Put a minecart on the tracks, hop in and press W Cannons & shipsStand by a cannon and right-click to fire where you look. Ship and submarine kits build walk-in vessels on water. Chickens lay eggs; place eggs to hatch them NukesPlace a nuke, then light it with a fire starter or a lever. You have 8 seconds to get far away. Nuke silos can be placed and aimed with direction, angle and power BossesThe Frost Giant roams snowy taiga, the Scorpion King rises from the desert, and the Shadow Dragon hunts at night Armor stands & dispensersHang armor and weapons on a stand. Fill a dispenser with armor and step in front of it to get suited up Enchanting & bone shiftersSpend levels at an enchanting table. Bone shifters change form with F, the bone drake horn summons skeletal drakes, and the gravity glove lets you lift and throw creatures Pistons & kitsSticky pistons pull blocks back. Secret door, drawbridge and monster trap kits build working contraptions in front of you Technique scrollsEight original ninja-style techniques: gale disc, ember breath, lightning step, mist veil, shadow bind, earthen fangs, spirit ward and gravity pulse Weapon packDaggers, rapiers, greatswords, maces, flails, halberds, tridents, whips, claws, crossbows, slingshots, boomerangs, chakrams, flamethrowers, rocket launchers, shotguns, miniguns and laser rifles Ninja weaponsSai (parry), katana, kama (sweeps), bo staff (long reach) and a blowgun with poison darts New gearFire starter, monster barriers, pistols, grenades, mechs, golems, landmines, pistons with levers, and five nature staffs Ninja stars / kunaiRight-click to throw. Walk over them to pick them back up Bow / spearHold right click to draw or wind up, release to shoot or throw Right click a boatGet in, then steer with W A S D ControllerRight-click to fly your drone.
